source_review.notes: Checked current gRPC deadline/cancellation guidance, Go context specification/guidance, Java SE 25 Future cancellation/timed-wait contract, POSIX clock_gettime semantics, AWS timeout guidance, OpenTelemetry RPC conventions and the cited distributed-systems, queueing and performance texts. Runtime phase coverage and cancellation behavior are version-qualified.

evidence: Checked parent/child deadlines, monotonic time, remaining budget, child maximum, reserve, minimum useful work, queue/attempt/residence and cancellation/effect notation.
Checked child derivation, admission, end-to-end phase sum and Little's-Law expressions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Timeout duration, deadline instant, cancellation signal and effect state remain distinct.

evidence: Recomputed executable output: root 5,000; remainder after 400 = 4,600; child min(4,700,2,600)=2,600; remainder at 2,700 = 2,300; 4,200+500+300=5,000 admitted and 4,201+500+300=5,001 rejected; three reset waits = 15,000.
Recomputed Exercise 2 child deadlines 1,250 and 1,750 ms and rejected 1,300+500+250=2,050 > 2,000.
Recomputed Exercise 3 residents: 600 times 0.2 = 120 and 600 times 1.5 = 900, a 7.5-fold ratio.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Arithmetic does not establish timer precision, task completion bounds, stability, capacity or causality.

evidence: Verified child non-extension from the minimum construction and inductive descent.
Verified admission preserves reserve under the declared completion premise.
Verified finite-root lifetime requires every queue/wait/call/task to cooperate; demonstrated why timeout/cancellation does not imply absence of effect.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Cross-clock uncertainty, scheduler delay and uncooperative operations limit the proofs.

evidence: Reviewed equality, one tick around boundary, zero/negative, resolution truncation, overflow, wall-clock jumps, skew/transit and process suspension.
Reviewed queue/acquire/DNS/TLS/body gaps, sequential/parallel children, retry reset, cancellation races, uninterruptible work, late callbacks and shutdown.
Reviewed ambiguous mutations, deadline abuse, stale/replayed commands, overload, durable detached work and safety-critical clock/effect failures.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Exact deployment, workload, security and safety properties require integration and named review.

evidence: Traced bounded ingress, child no-later-than-parent, monotonic local accounting, phase coverage, useful-work admission and reserve through examples/answers.
Traced descendant cancellation, late-result reaping, effect uncertainty, queue expiry, retry inheritance, capacity consequences and telemetry.
invariant_checking.notes: Cancellation is consistently a cooperative signal rather than rollback proof.

evidence: Reviewed non-extension, admission-safety and bounded-policy-lifetime arguments against their stated premises.
Reviewed cancellation-tree containment and effect-uncertainty counterexample.
Confirmed no universal deadline optimum is claimed from percentiles.
proof_review.notes: No formal proof of a runtime, transport, database effect, clock synchronization, availability or safety case is claimed.

evidence: Audited deadline, timeout, cancellation, rollback, bounded, monotonic, stable, safe, guarantee and proof language.
Confirmed protocol contracts, conditional proofs, arithmetic execution, empirical latency and external review are separated.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Timed waiting is never presented as guaranteed computation cancellation.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter distinguishes deadline intent, local timeout mechanism, cooperative cancellation and durable effect truth, then composes them through one inherited operation lifetime.

practitioner_review.notes: Guidance covers phase scope, ingress clamping, child/reserve derivation, clocks/protocols, cancellation trees, queueing/overload, late effects, calibration, telemetry, shutdown and high-stakes use.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with conditional proofs, executable boundaries, ten distinct cases and five exercises progressing from budget design through arithmetic, queueing, diagnosis and safety-critical judgment.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
